title: Public Service's Response to TAFEP Guideline on Mental Health Declaration
what_it_is: Public Service's Response to TAFEP Guideline on Mental Health Declaration

sections.label: Public Service job application health questions
sections.summary: Since 1 May 2017, the Singapore Public Service removed medical health declaration questions from job application forms and does not track applicants with mental health conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Since 1 May 2017, the Singapore Public Service has removed declaration questions on medical health from our Public Service job application forms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: We do not track the number of applicants with mental health conditions who have joined the Public Service.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The Public Service is also committed to providing our officers with an inclusive and mental-health friendly workplace.

sections.label: Counselling services in public agencies
sections.summary: The Public Service Division encourages public agencies to provide officers access to counselling, with 24/7 hotlines and face-to-face counselling in most agencies through Employee Assistance Programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The Public Service Division (PSD) is actively encouraging and facilitating public agencies to provide their officers with access to counselling services and, as such, 24/7 hotlines and face-to-face counselling are available in the majority of public agencies, which have put in place Employee Assistance Programmes.

sections.label: Public officers in HPB workshop
sections.summary: More than 500 public officers have participated in the HPB workshop so far, and more officers continue to be sent to the programme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: More than 500 public officers have participated in the HPB workshop so far and we continue to send more officers to the programme.

sections.label: No mental health leave, supervisor arrangements
sections.summary: There is no mental health leave at this point, but officers needing extra care for medical exigencies can contact supervisors to work out appropriate arrangements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: If Ms Anthea Ong has the specific details, we welcome her to provide MOE or PSD with the details and we can follow up on that.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: We do not have "mental health leave" at this point in time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: But I am sure if somebody, for medical exigencies, needs extra care, they can contact their respective supervisors and we can work out the appropriate arrangements.
